paragraphs.text: And the third day there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee; and the mother of Jesus was there:
paragraphs.original: Καὶ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ τρίτῃ γάμος ἐγένετο ἐν Κανὰ τῆς Γαλιλαίας, καὶ ἦν ἡ μήτηρ τοῦ Ἰησοῦ ἐκεῖ·
paragraphs.translit: Kai tē hēmera tē tritē gamos egeneto en Kana tēs Galilaias, kai ēn hē mētēr tou Iēsou ekei·

paragraphs.text: and Jesus also was bidden, and his disciples, to the marriage.
paragraphs.original: ἐκλήθη δὲ καὶ ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸν γάμον.
paragraphs.translit: eklēthē de kai ho Iēsous kai hoi mathētai autou eis ton gamon.

paragraphs.text: And when the wine failed, the mother of Jesus saith unto him, They have no wine.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ὑστερήσαντος οἴνου λέγει ἡ μήτηρ τοῦ Ἰησοῦ πρὸς αὐτόν· Οἶνον οὐκ ἔχουσιν.
paragraphs.translit: kai hysterēsantos oinou legei hē mētēr tou Iēsou pros auton· Oinon ouk echousin.

paragraphs.text: And Jesus saith unto her, Woman, what have I to do with thee? mine hour is not yet come.
paragraphs.original: καὶ λέγει αὐτῇ ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Τί ἐμοὶ καὶ σοί, γύναι; οὔπω ἥκει ἡ ὥρα μου.
paragraphs.translit: kai legei autē ho Iēsous· Ti emoi kai soi, gynai; oupō hēkei hē hōra mou.

paragraphs.text: His mother saith unto the servants, Whatsoever he saith unto you, do it.
paragraphs.original: λέγει ἡ μήτηρ αὐτοῦ τοῖς διακόνοις· Ὅ τι ἂν λέγῃ ὑμῖν ποιήσατε.
paragraphs.translit: legei hē mētēr autou tois diakonois· Ho ti an legē hymin poiēsate.

paragraphs.text: Now there were six waterpots of stone set there after the Jews` manner of purifying, containing two or three firkins apiece.
paragraphs.original: ἦσαν δὲ ἐκεῖ λίθιναι ὑδρίαι ἓξ κατὰ τὸν καθαρισμὸν τῶν Ἰουδαίων κείμεναι, χωροῦσαι ἀνὰ μετρητὰς δύο ἢ τρεῖς.
paragraphs.translit: ēsan de ekei lithinai hydriai hex kata ton katharismon tōn Ioudaiōn keimenai, chōrousai ana metrētas dyo ē treis.

paragraphs.text: Jesus saith unto them, Fill the waterpots with water. And they filled them up to the brim.
paragraphs.original: λέγει αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Γεμίσατε τὰς ὑδρίας ὕδατος· καὶ ἐγέμισαν αὐτὰς ἕως ἄνω.
paragraphs.translit: legei autois ho Iēsous· Gemisate tas hydrias hydatos· kai egemisan autas heōs anō.

paragraphs.text: And he saith unto them, Draw out now, and bear unto the ruler of the feast. And they bare it.
paragraphs.original: καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς· Ἀντλήσατε νῦν καὶ φέρετε τῷ ἀρχιτρικλίνῳ· οἱ δὲ ἤνεγκαν.
paragraphs.translit: kai legei autois· Antlēsate nyn kai pherete tō architriklinō· hoi de ēnenkan.

paragraphs.text: And when the ruler of the feast tasted the water now become wine, and knew not whence it was (but the servants that had drawn the water knew), the ruler of the feast calleth the bridegroom,
paragraphs.original: ὡς δὲ ἐγεύσατο ὁ ἀρχιτρίκλινος τὸ ὕδωρ οἶνον γεγενημένον, καὶ οὐκ ᾔδει πόθεν ἐστίν, οἱ δὲ διάκονοι ᾔδεισαν οἱ ἠντληκότες τὸ ὕδωρ, φωνεῖ τὸν νυμφίον ὁ ἀρχιτρίκλινος
paragraphs.translit: hōs de egeusato ho architriklinos to hydōr oinon gegenēmenon, kai ouk ēdei pothen estin, hoi de diakonoi ēdeisan hoi ēntlēkotes to hydōr, phōnei ton nymphion ho architriklinos

paragraphs.text: and saith unto him, Every man setteth on first the good wine; and when [men] have drunk freely, [then] that which is worse: thou hast kept the good wine until now.
paragraphs.original: καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ· Πᾶς ἄνθρωπος πρῶτον τὸν καλὸν οἶνον τίθησιν, καὶ ὅταν μεθυσθῶσιν τὸν ἐλάσσω· σὺ τετήρηκας τὸν καλὸν οἶνον ἕως ἄρτι.
paragraphs.translit: kai legei autō· Pas anthrōpos prōton ton kalon oinon tithēsin, kai hotan methysthōsin ton elassō· sy tetērēkas ton kalon oinon heōs arti.

paragraphs.text: This beginning of his signs did Jesus in Cana of Galilee, and manifested his glory; and his disciples believed on him.
paragraphs.original: ταύτην ἐποίησεν ἀρχὴν τῶν σημείων ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐν Κανὰ τῆς Γαλιλαίας καὶ ἐφανέρωσεν τὴν δόξαν αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐπίστευσαν εἰς αὐτὸν οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: tautēn epoiēsen archēn tōn sēmeiōn ho Iēsous en Kana tēs Galilaias kai ephanerōsen tēn doxan autou, kai episteusan eis auton hoi mathētai autou.

paragraphs.text: After this he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, and [his] brethren, and his disciples; and there they abode not many days.
paragraphs.original: Μετὰ τοῦτο κατέβη εἰς Καφαρναοὺμ αὐτὸς καὶ ἡ μήτηρ αὐτοῦ καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ καὶ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐκεῖ ἔμειναν οὐ πολλὰς ἡμέρας.
paragraphs.translit: Meta touto katebē eis Kapharnaoum autos kai hē mētēr autou kai hoi adelphoi kai hoi mathētai autou, kai ekei emeinan ou pollas hēmeras.

paragraphs.text: And the passover of the Jews was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
paragraphs.original: Καὶ ἐγγὺς ἦν τὸ πάσχα τῶν Ἰουδαίων, καὶ ἀνέβη εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα ὁ Ἰησοῦς.
paragraphs.translit: Kai engys ēn to pascha tōn Ioudaiōn, kai anebē eis Hierosolyma ho Iēsous.

paragraphs.text: And he found in the temple those that sold oxen and sheep and doves, and the changers of money sitting:
paragraphs.original: καὶ εὗρεν ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ τοὺς πωλοῦντας βόας καὶ πρόβατα καὶ περιστερὰς καὶ τοὺς κερματιστὰς καθημένους,
paragraphs.translit: kai heuren en tō hierō tous pōlountas boas kai probata kai peristeras kai tous kermatistas kathēmenous,

paragraphs.text: and he made a scourge of cords, and cast all out of the temple, both the sheep and the oxen; and he poured out the changers` money, and overthrew their tables;
paragraphs.original: καὶ ποιήσας φραγέλλιον ἐκ σχοινίων πάντας ἐξέβαλεν ἐκ τοῦ ἱεροῦ τά τε πρόβατα καὶ τοὺς βόας, καὶ τῶν κολλυβιστῶν ἐξέχεεν τὰ κέρματα καὶ τὰς τραπέζας ἀνέστρεψεν,
paragraphs.translit: kai poiēsas phragellion ek schoiniōn pantas exebalen ek tou hierou ta te probata kai tous boas, kai tōn kollybistōn execheen ta kermata kai tas trapezas anestrepsen,

paragraphs.text: and to them that sold the doves he said, Take these things hence; make not my Father`s house a house of merchandise.
paragraphs.original: καὶ τοῖς τὰς περιστερὰς πωλοῦσιν εἶπεν· Ἄρατε ταῦτα ἐντεῦθεν, μὴ ποιεῖτε τὸν οἶκον τοῦ πατρός μου οἶκον ἐμπορίου.
paragraphs.translit: kai tois tas peristeras pōlousin eipen· Arate tauta enteuthen, mē poieite ton oikon tou patros mou oikon emporiou.

paragraphs.text: His disciples remembered that it was written, Zeal for thy house shall eat me up.
paragraphs.original: ἐμνήσθησαν οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ ὅτι γεγραμμένον ἐστίν· Ὁ ζῆλος τοῦ οἴκου σου καταφάγεταί με.
paragraphs.translit: emnēsthēsan hoi mathētai autou hoti gegrammenon estin· Ho zēlos tou oikou sou kataphagetai me.

paragraphs.text: The Jews therefore answered and said unto him, What sign showest thou unto us, seeing that thou doest these things?
paragraphs.original: ἀπεκρίθησαν οὖν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ· Τί σημεῖον δεικνύεις ἡμῖν, ὅτι ταῦτα ποιεῖς;
paragraphs.translit: apekrithēsan oun hoi Ioudaioi kai eipan autō· Ti sēmeion deiknyeis hēmin, hoti tauta poieis;

paragraphs.text: Jesus answered and said unto them, Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.
paragraphs.original: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Λύσατε τὸν ναὸν τοῦτον καὶ ἐν τρισὶν ἡμέραις ἐγερῶ αὐτόν.
paragraphs.translit: apekrithē Iēsous kai eipen autois· Lysate ton naon touton kai en trisin hēmerais egerō auton.

paragraphs.text: The Jews therefore said, Forty and six years was this temple in building, and wilt thou raise it up in three days?
paragraphs.original: εἶπαν οὖν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι· Τεσσεράκοντα καὶ ἓξ ἔτεσιν οἰκοδομήθη ὁ ναὸς οὗτος, καὶ σὺ ἐν τρισὶν ἡμέραις ἐγερεῖς αὐτόν;
paragraphs.translit: eipan oun hoi Ioudaioi· Tesserakonta kai hex etesin oikodomēthē ho naos houtos, kai sy en trisin hēmerais egereis auton;

paragraphs.text: But he spake of the temple of his body.
paragraphs.original: ἐκεῖνος δὲ ἔλεγεν περὶ τοῦ ναοῦ τοῦ σώματος αὐτοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: ekeinos de elegen peri tou naou tou sōmatos autou.

paragraphs.text: When therefore he was raised from the dead, his disciples remembered that he spake this; and they believed the scripture, and the word which Jesus had said.
paragraphs.original: ὅτε οὖν ἠγέρθη ἐκ νεκρῶν, ἐμνήσθησαν οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ ὅτι τοῦτο ἔλεγεν, καὶ ἐπίστευσαν τῇ γραφῇ καὶ τῷ λόγῳ ὃν εἶπεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς.
paragraphs.translit: hote oun ēgerthē ek nekrōn, emnēsthēsan hoi mathētai autou hoti touto elegen, kai episteusan tē graphē kai tō logō hon eipen ho Iēsous.

paragraphs.text: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the passover, during the feast, many believed on his name, beholding his signs which he did.
paragraphs.original: Ὡς δὲ ἦν ἐν τοῖς Ἱεροσολύμοις ἐν τῷ πάσχα ἐν τῇ ἑορτῇ, πολλοὶ ἐπίστευσαν εἰς τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ, θεωροῦντες αὐτοῦ τὰ σημεῖα ἃ ἐποίει·
paragraphs.translit: Hōs de ēn en tois Hierosolymois en tō pascha en tē heortē, polloi episteusan eis to onoma autou, theōrountes autou ta sēmeia ha epoiei·

paragraphs.text: But Jesus did not trust himself unto them, for that he knew all men,
paragraphs.original: αὐτὸς δὲ Ἰησοῦς οὐκ ἐπίστευεν αὑτὸν αὐτοῖς διὰ τὸ αὐτὸν γινώσκειν πάντας
paragraphs.translit: autos de Iēsous ouk episteuen hauton autois dia to auton ginōskein pantas

paragraphs.text: and because he needed not that any one should bear witness concerning man; for he himself knew what was in man.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ὅτι οὐ χρείαν εἶχεν ἵνα τις μαρτυρήσῃ περὶ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου, αὐτὸς γὰρ ἐγίνωσκεν τί ἦν ἐν τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ.
paragraphs.translit: kai hoti ou chreian eichen hina tis martyrēsē peri tou anthrōpou, autos gar eginōsken ti ēn en tō anthrōpō.
